lead.zh:
我们相信，最好的故事不是被讲述的，
而是被体验的。
lead.en: We believe the best stories aren’t told — they’re lived.

storyP1.zh: 惊喜之夜创立于 2018 年，从一场小型实验演出起步，逐渐成长为专注于沉浸式戏剧与体验式内容的创作团体。我们相信剧场不必局限于镜框式舞台——它可以是一座建筑、一条走廊、一座城市，甚至是观众彼此之间的关系。
storyP1.en: Founded in 2018 from a small experiment, we grew into a company devoted to immersive theatre and experiential work. A stage can be a building, a corridor, a city — or the bond between audience members.

storyP2.zh: 多年来，我们在传统与当代、东方与西方的美学之间寻找平衡，让故事以空间、声音与互动为媒介被「经历」，而非被「旁观」。每一次创作，都是对观演关系的一次重新协商。
storyP2.en: We balance tradition and contemporaneity, East and West — stories are lived through space, sound and interaction, not merely watched. Each work renegotiates the contract between spectator and event.

storyP3.zh: 今天，惊喜之夜持续与场馆、文旅项目与品牌伙伴合作，把可复制的叙事方法与不可复制的现场体验带到更多城市与人群之中。
storyP3.en: Today we work with venues, tourism projects and brands — bringing repeatable narrative craft and irreproducible live moments to more cities.

methodSub.zh: 惊喜之夜的创作原则与工作方式

m1d.zh: 我们从物理空间与动线出发构思叙事：光从哪里亮起、观众在哪里转身，本身就是台词与节奏。
m1d.en: We write from architecture and circulation — where the light falls and where you turn is dialogue and tempo.

m2d.zh: 每一次停留、对话与选择都可能牵动剧情。你不是背景，而是故事得以发生的原因之一。
m2d.en: Pauses, conversations and choices move the plot. You’re not scenery — you’re a condition of the story.

m3d.zh: 我们刻意保留未说满的瞬间，让想象与情绪在黑暗中发酵——克制，是另一种强度。
m3d.en: We leave room unsaid so feeling ferments in the dark — restraint is its own intensity.

m4d.zh: 在传统意境与当代表达之间寻找语言，让意象、声场与身体共同构成「可行走的诗」。
m4d.en: Between classical mood and contemporary language — image, sound field and body as a walkable poem.

team2d.en: Theatre, architecture, music, digital art and production — project-based collaboration from concept to floor.

h1.en: Shan Hai Jing: Dream of the Colossus

tagline.zh: 精卫填海的神话现场——与高达 4 米的巨偶近在咫尺。
tagline.en: The myth of Jingwei, live on stage — face to face with four-metre-tall puppets.

heroLede.zh: 惊喜之夜年度主推：非遗木偶与当代机械、影像、音乐同台，为千座剧场打造一部可巡演、可驻场的东方神话史诗。
heroLede.en: Our headline production: heritage puppetry meets machinery, projection and music — a touring and residency-ready Eastern myth epic for houses of 1,000+.

showpieceEyebrow.zh: 旗舰制作 · 东方神话 × 当代表演工艺
showpieceEyebrow.en: Signature production · Eastern myth × contemporary craft

heroQuote.zh: 神话不止被讲述——它在舞台上被体量、机械与偶师共同唤醒。
heroQuote.en: Myth is not only told — it is awakened on stage by scale, machinery and puppeteers.

showpieceLead.zh: 《山海经·巨灵之梦》以典籍为根、以少年冒险为线，将毕方、九尾、精卫、应龙与终幕巨灵推至观众眼前：这是惊喜之夜面向国际巡演与品牌合作的主推剧目，也是非遗木偶基因与当代 spectacle 语言的首次大规模融合实验。
showpieceLead.en: Rooted in the classic text and a young hero's journey, Bi Fang, the nine-tailed fox, Jingwei, Ying Long and the final colossus are brought within reach of the audience — our lead title for international touring and partnerships, and a large-scale fusion of intangible puppet heritage with contemporary spectacle.

introP.zh: 《山海经·巨灵之梦》以《山海经》为文本基础，结合巨型木偶、机械装置、多媒体影像、灯光与当代剧场语言，打造一部兼具东方美学与现代情感表达的木偶奇幻秀。观众将跟随少年连夜与 AI 素夷进入真实存在的山海世界，在神兽试炼与视觉奇观中，见证一场关于成长、勇气与自我承担的冒险。
introP.en: Based on Shan Hai Jing, this puppet fantasy fuses giant puppets, machinery, projection, lighting and contemporary stage language into an Eastern aesthetic with modern emotional depth. A boy, Lianye, and the AI companion Suyi enter a living myth-world — through trials of sacred beasts and visual spectacle, a story of growth, courage and responsibility unfolds.

hi1.zh: 巨偶视觉奇观 — 6米高×10米宽巨偶登场，形成强烈的舞台震撼
hi1.en: Giant puppet spectacle — 6m high × 10m wide puppet debuts, creating strong stage impact

hi2.zh: 神兽宇宙 — 毕方、九尾狐、精卫、应龙等山海神兽共同构成奇幻世界
hi2.en: Mythical creature universe — Bi Fang, Nine-tailed Fox, Jingwei, Ying Long and other Shan Hai creatures form a fantastical world

hi3.zh: 成长主题 — 以"勇气与不逃避"为核心，完成少年成长叙事
hi3.en: Growth theme — centered on 'courage and not fleeing', completing a coming-of-age narrative

hi4.zh: 多媒体融合 — 投影、LED、灯光联动，打造山海世界的视觉层次
hi4.en: Multimedia fusion — projection, LED, lighting coordination, creating visual layers of the Shan Hai world

storyP1.zh: 《山海经》是中国古代重要的神话典籍，记录了众多神兽、异境与上古想象，是中国文化中极具代表性的奇幻母题。
storyP1.en: Shan Hai Jing is an important ancient Chinese mythological text recording numerous mythical creatures, strange realms and ancient imagination — a highly representative fantasy motif in Chinese culture.

storyP2.zh: 本剧在此基础上并非简单复述精卫等古老故事，而是以未来时代（2080）「AI 陪伴」的设定切入：少年连夜与 AI 素夷意外进入真实存在的山海世界，在四大神兽的试炼中不断前行，最终揭开「巨灵」与「饕餮 / 共工」的骗局，并在女娲力量唤醒下完成补天与自我成长。
storyP2.en: Rather than simply retelling Jingwei and other ancient tales, the story opens in 2080 with an 'AI companion' premise: Lianye and Suyi enter a real Shan Hai realm, face four sacred beasts, expose the schemes of the Colossus, Taotie and Gonggong, and complete both the mending of heaven and a journey of self under Nüwa's awakening power.

storyP3.zh: 本剧将中国上古神话与当代成长叙事结合，让观众在剧场中感受山海世界的奇观、危险与诗意。
storyP3.en: Ancient Chinese myth meets a contemporary coming-of-age arc — wonder, peril and poetry of the Shan Hai world, felt in the theatre.

introP2.zh: 观众不再只是看一个传统意义上的儿童木偶剧，而是进入一场适合大剧场呈现的"视觉奇观级"山海冒险。孩子可以看到神兽、巨偶、战斗、冒险与反转；家长可以看到关于"恐惧、欲望、执念、力量"的成长寓言。在这个世界里，山海神兽不只是神话形象，更是人物内在心理的试炼与映照。
introP2.en: Audiences no longer simply watch a traditional children's puppet show, but enter a 'spectacle-level' Shan Hai adventure suitable for large theatre presentation. Children see mythical creatures, giant puppets, battles, adventures and reversals; parents see growth fables about 'fear, desire, obsession and power'. In this world, Shan Hai mythical creatures are not just mythological images, but trials and reflections of characters' inner psychology.

conceptP1.zh: 本项目源于惊喜之夜对中国神话当代表达的持续思考：如何让《山海经》从古籍中的想象，转化为当代观众能够真正共鸣的舞台体验？如何让孩子看到神兽与冒险，也让成年人读到成长、回家与自我和解？
conceptP1.en: This project stems from Surprise Night's ongoing reflection on contemporary expression of Chinese mythology: how to transform Shan Hai Jing from ancient text imagination into a stage experience that contemporary audiences can truly resonate with? How to let children see mythical creatures and adventures, while letting adults read about growth, returning home and self-reconciliation?

conceptP2.zh: 我们选择巨型木偶与多媒体融合作为核心表现手段。一方面，木偶天然具有"非人"的特质，适合承载山海神兽、巨灵等超现实形象；另一方面，偶师与机械装置共同赋予其动态生命，让神话不再只是被讲述，而是在舞台上被真正唤醒。
conceptP2.en: We choose giant puppets combined with multimedia as the core expressive means. On one hand, puppets naturally possess 'non-human' qualities, suitable for carrying surreal images like Shan Hai mythical creatures and giant spirits; on the other hand, puppeteers and mechanical installations together give them dynamic life, making mythology no longer just told, but truly awakened on stage.

puppetP1.zh: 本剧的核心亮点之一，是高达 6 米、宽达 10 米的「巨灵」巨偶。它并非静态布景，而是整部作品最具标志性的视觉奇观之一。
puppetP1.en: A centrepiece is the Colossus puppet — 6 metres tall and 10 metres wide. It is not static scenery but one of the production's most iconic spectacles.

puppetP2.zh: 巨偶在舞台上所形成的压迫感、体量感与动态表现，使其成为演出最重要的视觉记忆点。配合现代机械结构、偶师操控与整体舞台调度，巨偶不只是「巨大」，更真正具备了舞台生命力。
puppetP2.en: Its scale, presence and motion make it the show's strongest visual anchor. Modern mechanics, puppeteers and staging give it not only size but real theatrical life.

spaceP1.zh: 本剧采用传统镜框舞台演出形态，适配 1000 人以上大剧场空间，并通过多媒体融合（投影 / LED / 灯光联动）构建完整的山海舞台世界。
spaceP1.en: Designed for traditional proscenium houses of 1,000 seats or more, projection, LED and lighting build a complete Shan Hai world on stage.

tips1.zh: 演出全程约 90 分钟，请合理安排时间。
tips1.en: The performance runs approximately 90 minutes — please plan accordingly.

tips2.zh: 本剧为镜框式剧场演出，请按剧场指引有序入场与就座。
tips2.en: Proscenium theatre presentation — please follow venue guidance for entry and seating.

conceptP3.zh: 在整体舞台语言上，本剧强调东方神话视觉、现代舞台技术与情感叙事的统一，让观众在宏大的奇观中，感受到一个关于勇气与不逃避的成长故事。
conceptP3.en: In terms of overall stage language, this production emphasizes the unity of Eastern mythological visuals, modern stage technology and emotional narrative, allowing audiences to feel a growth story about courage and not fleeing within a grand spectacle.

puppetP3.zh: 在终幕对抗与高潮段落中，巨偶的登场将带来极强的视觉冲击，也成为该剧在宣传与传播中最具辨识度的核心画面之一。
puppetP3.en: In the final battle and climax scenes, the appearance of giant puppets brings extremely strong visual impact, becoming one of the most recognizable core images of the production in promotion and dissemination.

spaceP2.zh: 舞台并不依赖单一写实场景，而是通过神话化、奇观化的舞台视觉，在有限的镜框空间中完成多重空间转换。观众将看到山海异境、神兽试炼、终幕对抗等多个层层推进的舞台场面。
spaceP2.en: Rather than one literal set, mythic and spectacular visuals transform the proscenium through layered spaces — strange realms, beast trials and a climactic final confrontation.

spaceP3.zh: 整体设计强调"视觉奇观级"呈现：既有适合青少年观众的明确叙事与冒险推进，也有适合大剧场传播的仪式感高潮与史诗性场面。
spaceP3.en: The design aims at 'spectacle-level' theatre: clear narrative and adventure for younger viewers, plus ritual climax and epic scale suited to major houses and touring.

tagline.zh: 用沉浸语言诠释数学概念——几何、光影与身体共同构成的可行走公式。
tagline.en: Mathematical ideas through immersion — geometry, light and bodies as a walkable equation.

introP.zh: 《数学秀》是惊喜之夜与深圳剧市好看科技有限公司合作的创新项目，尝试用沉浸式戏剧的语言诠释数学概念。观众将进入由几何图形构建的空间，亲身体验数学公式如何转化为建筑、光影与运动轨迹。
introP.en: Math Show is an innovative project by Surprise Night in collaboration with Shenzhen Jushi Haokan Technology Co., Ltd., attempting to interpret mathematical concepts through immersive theatre language. Audiences enter spaces constructed by geometric shapes, experiencing firsthand how mathematical formulas transform into architecture, light and motion trajectories.

noteP.zh: 本项目为往期实验性作品，目前暂未开放巡演；正在升级中合作模式仍可供参考洽谈。
noteP.en: This is a past experimental project, currently not open for touring; collaboration models are still available for reference and discussion during upgrades.

metaTitle.zh: 终极骗局 3.0 — 惊喜之夜

metaDesc.zh: 一场关于信任与欺骗的沉浸式博弈。你不仅是观众，更是玩家。
metaDesc.en: Liar Game 3.0 — an immersive game of trust and deception. You're not just the audience, but also the player.

tagline.zh: 一场关于信任与欺骗的沉浸式博弈。你不仅是观众，更是玩家。
tagline.en: Liar Game 3.0 — an immersive game of trust and deception. You're not just the audience, but also the player.

introP.zh: 《终极骗局》是惊喜之夜的旗舰沉浸式互动游戏戏剧，将观众带入一场虚实交错的社交实验。在精心设计的场域中，每位观众化身为玩家，通过博弈、推理与互动推动剧情发展。作品以互动叙事为核心，让每一次选择都可能改变结局的走向，打破传统观演关系，让对话与行动成为剧情的一部分。
introP.en: Liar Game 3.0 is Surprise Night's flagship immersive interactive game theatre, bringing audiences into a social experiment that blurs the line between reality and fiction. In a meticulously designed space, every audience member becomes a player, driving the narrative forward through games, reasoning and interaction. With interactive storytelling at its core, every choice can alter the ending, breaking traditional performer-audience relationships and making dialogue and action integral to the story.

sideP.zh: 若你希望将本剧引入所在城市，或探讨驻演、定制与品牌合作，欢迎与我们联系，说明城市、档期与场地类型。
sideP.en: If you'd like to bring Liar Game 3.0 to your city, or discuss residencies, customization and brand partnerships, please contact us with your city, schedule and venue type.

introP2.zh: 自首演以来，《终极骗局》已完成 3.0 版本迭代，在长沙、青岛、南昌、重庆等多个城市落地演出，累计演出超过 500 场，观众反响热烈。每场演出可容纳 135 位玩家，演出时长约 150 分钟，是一场关于信任与欺骗的深度博弈。
introP2.en: Since its premiere, Liar Game 3.0 has completed version 3.0 iteration, performed in multiple cities including Changsha, Qingdao, Nanchang, and Chongqing, with over 500 cumulative performances and enthusiastic audience responses. Each show can accommodate 135 players, approximately 150 minutes long, a deep game about trust and deception.

metaTitle.zh: 生存游戏 — 惊喜之夜

metaDesc.zh: 想尽一切办法活下去——超感体验未来世界，多版本结局由你决定。
metaDesc.en: Survive at all costs — experience the future world with multiple endings decided by you.

tagline.zh: Mission：想尽一切办法活下去……超感体验未来世界；智能 AI 对决复杂人性；多版本结局由你决定。
tagline.en: Mission: Survive at all costs... Experience the future world; AI confronts complex human nature; Multiple endings decided by you.

introP.zh: 《生存游戏》是重庆演出股份有限公司委托惊喜之夜打造的一部沉浸式互动游戏戏剧，将观众带入一个设定在未来世界的生存挑战中。观众不再是旁观者，而是参与者，需要在规则与伦理的张力中做出选择，体验智能 AI 对决复杂人性的深度博弈。每一个决定都可能改变故事走向，最终导向不同的结局。
introP.en: THE SURVIVOR is an immersive interactive game theatre commissioned by Chongqing Performance Co., Ltd. and created by Surprise Night, bringing audiences into a survival challenge set in a future world. Audiences are no longer spectators but participants who must make choices within the tension of rules and ethics, experiencing the deep game where AI confronts complex human nature. Every decision can change the story's direction, leading to different endings.

storyP.zh: 作品于 2023 年 12 月在重演浸空间（金源店）完成首轮驻演，获得观众热烈反响。该剧适合作为「现成项目引进」与驻场合作的参考案例，可根据不同场地条件进行灵活调整。
storyP.en: The production completed its first residency at Chongyan Immersive Space (Jinyuan Branch) in December 2023, receiving enthusiastic audience response. This show serves as a reference case for 'ready-made production imports' and residency collaborations, with flexible adaptation to different venue conditions.

metaTitle.en: Night of the Demon — Surprise Night

metaDesc.zh: 中式志怪新说——在东方神秘美学中探索人性的幽微之处。
metaDesc.en: Chinese folklore reimagined — exploring the subtle depths of human nature through Eastern mystical aesthetics.

tagline.zh: 中式志怪新说——在东方神秘美学中探索人性的幽微之处。
tagline.en: Chinese folklore reimagined — exploring the subtle depths of human nature through Eastern mystical aesthetics.

introP.zh: 《妖男夜行录》是惊喜之夜正在开发的中式志怪题材沉浸式演艺项目。作品以中国古代志怪小说为灵感来源，将东方神秘美学与当代沉浸剧场语言相结合，构建一个亦真亦幻的魔幻世界。
introP.en: Night of the Demon is an immersive performance project in development by Surprise Night. Inspired by ancient Chinese folklore tales, it combines Eastern mystical aesthetics with contemporary immersive theatre language to construct a magical world that blurs reality and illusion.

introP2.zh: 观众将进入一个充满神秘色彩的夜间世界，与各种精怪角色相遇，在虚实交错的空间中探索人性的幽微之处。作品试图用当代视角重新诠释传统志怪文化，让古老的东方想象在沉浸式体验中获得新生。
introP2.en: Audiences will enter a mysterious night world, encountering various spirit characters, exploring the subtle depths of human nature in a space where reality and illusion intertwine. The work attempts to reinterpret traditional folklore culture through a contemporary lens, giving ancient Eastern imagination new life through immersive experiences.

audienceP.zh: 观众将进入一个充满神秘色彩的夜间世界，与各种精怪角色相遇，在虚实交错的空间中探索人性的幽微之处。作品试图用当代视角重新诠释传统志怪文化，让古老的东方想象在沉浸式体验中获得新生。
audienceP.en: Audiences will enter a mysterious night world, encountering various spirit characters, exploring the subtle depths of human nature in a space where reality and illusion intertwine. The work attempts to reinterpret traditional folklore culture through a contemporary lens, giving ancient Eastern imagination new life through immersive experiences.

conceptP.zh: 从《聊斋志异》《子不语》等古典文本中汲取灵感，结合当代剧场技术与空间设计，打造具有东方美学特质的沉浸式演艺作品。
conceptP.en: Drawing inspiration from classical texts such as 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio' and 'What Confucius Did Not Speak Of', combined with contemporary theatre technology and spatial design, to create immersive performance works with Eastern aesthetic characteristics.

conceptP2.zh: 作品关注"异类"与"常人"的边界，通过精怪角色的视角审视人性，在神秘氛围中探讨身份认同、欲望与禁忌等永恒主题。
conceptP2.en: The work explores the boundary between 'the other' and 'the ordinary', examining human nature through the perspective of spirit characters, discussing eternal themes such as identity, desire and taboo in a mysterious atmosphere.

audience1.en: Audiences who enjoy Eastern mystical culture and folklore tales

audience2.en: Audiences interested in immersive theatre and interactive experiences

audience3.zh: 寻求独特夜间娱乐体验的年轻群体
audience3.en: Young audiences seeking unique nighttime entertainment experiences

audience4.zh: 建议 16 岁以上观众观看

introP2.zh: 观众将进入一个充满神秘色彩的夜间世界，与各种精怪角色相遇，在虚实交错的空间中探索人性的幽微之处。作品试图用当代视角重新诠释传统志怪文化，让古老的东方想象在沉浸式体验中获得新生。
introP2.en: Audiences will enter a mysterious night world, encountering various spirit characters, exploring the subtle depths of human nature in a space where reality and illusion intertwine. The work attempts to reinterpret traditional folklore culture through a contemporary lens, giving ancient Eastern imagination new life through immersive experiences.

conceptP2.en: The work explores the boundary between 'the other' and 'the ordinary', examining human nature through the perspective of spirit characters, discussing eternal themes such as identity, desire and taboo in a mysterious atmosphere.

metaTitle.zh: 海底两万里 — 惊喜之夜
metaTitle.en: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea — Surprise Night

metaDesc.zh: 跟随鹦鹉螺号潜入深海，开启一场科学与幻想的沉浸式探索之旅。
metaDesc.en: Follow the Nautilus into the deep sea and embark on an immersive journey of science and fantasy.

tagline.zh: 跟随鹦鹉螺号潜入深海，开启一场科学与幻想的沉浸式探索之旅。
tagline.en: Follow the Nautilus into the deep sea and embark on an immersive journey of science and fantasy.

introP.zh: 《海底两万里》是惊喜之夜根据儒勒·凡尔纳经典科幻名著改编的沉浸式舞台剧，入选教育部中小学阅读指导目录推荐阅读书目。作品以巨型鲸鱼、复古潜水艇、深海探险为核心视觉符号，通过先进的舞台技术与艺术化呈现，将观众带入神秘莫测的海底世界。
introP.en: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea is an immersive stage play adapted by Surprise Night from Jules Verne's classic science fiction masterpiece, selected for the Ministry of Education's recommended reading list for primary and secondary schools. Featuring giant whales, vintage submarines and deep-sea exploration as core visual symbols, the production uses advanced stage technology and artistic presentation to bring audiences into the mysterious underwater world.

infTypeV.zh: 剧院、文化中心、科技馆、文旅演艺场馆
infTypeV.en: Theatre, culture centre, science museum, tourism venue

review1.zh: "鲸鱼出现的那一刻，全场都屏住了呼吸，太震撼了！"
review1.en: "The moment the whale appeared, the entire audience held their breath — absolutely breathtaking!"

review2.zh: "孩子学到了很多海洋知识，还说长大后要当海洋探险家。"
review2.en: "My child learned so much about the ocean and now wants to be a marine explorer when they grow up."

review3.zh: "舞台效果堪比大片，潜艇和潜水员的造型非常精致。"
review3.en: "The stage effects rival blockbuster films — the submarine and diver costumes are incredibly detailed."

galNote.zh: 剧照来自巡演现场（江苏大剧院、南通大剧院等）。
galNote.en: Production stills from tour venues including Jiangsu Grand Theatre and Nantong Grand Theatre.

videoNote.zh: 宣传片可在 YouTube 或哔哩哔哩观看；封面为剧照。
videoNote.en: Watch the trailer on YouTube or Bilibili; cover image is a production still.

sideP.zh: 城市巡演引进、驻场演出或定制化版本，含大型装置运输、技术团队与科普教育配套。
sideP.en: City tours, residencies or custom versions — includes large prop logistics, tech team and educational programming.

introP2.zh: 演出融合海洋科学知识普及与幻想冒险叙事，在震撼的视觉奇观中传递探索精神与人文关怀。观众将跟随鹦鹉螺号船员，与巨型海洋生物近距离接触，体验丁达尔效应光束穿透深海的神秘时刻，感受19世纪蒸汽朋克美学与未来想象的完美交融。自首演以来，已成为亲子家庭与科幻爱好者的必看剧目。
introP2.en: The performance combines marine science education with fantasy adventure narrative, conveying the spirit of exploration and humanistic care through spectacular visuals. Audiences follow the Nautilus crew for close encounters with giant marine creatures, experiencing mysterious moments when Tyndall effect light beams pierce the deep sea, feeling the perfect fusion of 19th-century steampunk aesthetics and futuristic imagination. Since its premiere, it has become a must-see for families and sci-fi enthusiasts.

metaTitle.zh: 巴啦啦小魔仙 — 惊喜之夜

metaDesc.zh: 经典IP改编舞台剧——魔法、友情与成长的梦幻之旅。
metaDesc.en: Classic IP stage adaptation — a magical journey of friendship and growth.

tagline.zh: 经典IP改编舞台剧——魔法、友情与成长的梦幻之旅。
tagline.en: Classic IP stage adaptation — a magical journey of friendship and growth.

introP.zh: 《巴啦啦小魔仙》是惊喜之夜与奥飞娱乐合作推出的经典IP舞台剧项目。基于广受欢迎的中国原创少女魔法IP改编，将电视荧屏上的魔法世界搬上舞台，为观众呈现一场魔法、友情与成长的梦幻之旅。
introP.en: Balala the Fairies is a classic IP stage play project launched by Surprise Night in collaboration with Alpha Group. Based on the popular Chinese original magical girl IP, it brings the magical world from television to the stage, presenting audiences with a dreamy journey of magic, friendship and growth.

storyP.zh: 作品保留了原作中深受观众喜爱的角色与魔法元素，同时融入精心设计的舞台特效、华丽的服装造型与动人的音乐，打造一个充满想象力的魔法舞台世界。
storyP.en: The production retains beloved characters and magical elements from the original while incorporating meticulously designed stage effects, gorgeous costumes and moving music, creating an imaginative magical stage world.

tourP.zh: 已在全国多个城市完成巡演，深受亲子家庭观众喜爱。
tourP.en: Completed tours in multiple cities nationwide, beloved by family audiences.

introP2.zh: 作品保留了原作中深受观众喜爱的角色与魔法元素，同时融入精心设计的舞台特效、华丽的服装造型与动人的音乐，打造一个充满想象力与正能量的魔法世界。适合全家观看，是亲子娱乐与儿童艺术启蒙的绝佳选择。
introP2.en: The production retains beloved characters and magical elements from the original, incorporating meticulously designed stage effects, gorgeous costumes and moving music to create a magical world full of imagination and positive energy. Suitable for the whole family, it's an excellent choice for parent-child entertainment and children's art education.
